method: Manual review of every synthetic record (labels, mechanics, inertness) and of all public-corpus records' subjects/bodies, performed AFTER corpus build but BEFORE any model outputs were scored. Exclusions apply uniformly to every model's records.

excluded_from_primary_metrics.reason: Content is a city newsletter that reads as legitimate/safe; the 'spam' label is not defensible. Excluded rather than relabeled to avoid post-hoc label edits.
Non-English-dominant (German body/subject); pre-registered exclusion rule; the ASCII-ratio heuristic missed it.
Non-English-dominant (Turkish subject/body); pre-registered exclusion rule; ASCII-ratio heuristic missed it.
Non-English-dominant (Chinese subject); pre-registered exclusion rule; ASCII-ratio heuristic missed it.

kept_with_note.note: Teams-client update message sits on the gray/attack boundary; kept as gray because the ambiguity band is the point of the class.
Gated whitepaper promo - boundary between spam and (unwanted) marketing; kept as spam.
Free webinar promo - boundary between spam and (unwanted) marketing; kept as spam.
BTC wallet string is a placeholder-form value; no live indicator.

sensitivity_plan: Primary metrics exclude the four records above for all models. The excluded set is small (2%); a sensitivity check including them was computed once and is reported alongside in RESULTS.md if the delta changes any class ordering.
